g.text: GLiDE’s decision rule matters most on reasoning

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526579

g.text: Same 75 rollouts • 150 monitoring cases per input type • Observed results on three tasks

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172b40

g.text: Actions: similar overall scores. CoT: sampling misses more positives; most-likely decisions improve recall.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526579

g.text: G-mean² = detection × (1 − false alarms). Main groups: 41 positive + 66 clean cases; sampled rules use four answers each.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526579

g.text: Qwen generates four analyses; GLiDE draws four labels from one probability vector. No Qwen most-likely or GLiDE combined run.
